policies.heading: Orchestrator — dispatch to the team
policies.title: Orchestrator
policies.pointer: Every session starts as the **orchestrator** — route multi-step work to the roster member whose model and skills fit (`npm run orchestrator:route -- "<task>"`).
policies.cursorDescription: Dispatch multi-step work to the agent roster — member, skills, and model tier come from scripts/lib/orchestrator/roster.json.

policies.heading: Isolate in a worktree
policies.title: Worktree
policies.pointer: **Worktree** isolation for parallel agents — create before the first edit, remove when done.
policies.cursorDescription: Worktree isolation — create before first edit; remove when done.

policies.heading: Agent handoff — out-of-scope issues
policies.title: Agent handoff
policies.pointer: File **agent-handoff** issues for out-of-scope failures instead of fixing inline.
policies.cursorDescription: File GitHub issues for out-of-scope errors so another agent can pick them up.

policies.heading: Builder ↔ app contract
policies.title: Builder ↔ app contract
policies.pointer: Venue **builder** output is generated only — fix upstream, prove in the app.
policies.cursorDescription: Keep the venue builder and the app's data contract in sync — fix generated data upstream, validate app changes against the builder.

policies.heading: Claude Design — where the front end is designed
policies.title: Claude Design
policies.pointer: **Claude Design** is canon for how the front end looks and reads — the code conforms to it; the repo is canon only for what a canvas cannot see.
policies.cursorDescription: Claude Design is authoritative for front-end design; verify its facts against the code, but do not overrule its judgement on layout, hierarchy or copy.

policies.heading: Vertical e2e — output validation
policies.title: Vertical e2e
policies.pointer: All code work is proven **end to end** with the run's output asserted — `npm run test:pre-merge-vertical` gates it.
policies.cursorDescription: Prove code work end to end and assert the run's output; static steps are the floor, not the proof.

policies.heading: App version — auto-bumped on merge
policies.title: App version
policies.pointer: App **version** is auto-bumped on merge — never edit version files in PRs.
policies.cursorDescription: App semver is auto-bumped on merge to main — never edit version files in PRs.

policies.heading: Vercel previews
policies.title: Vercel previews
policies.pointer: **Vercel** previews are user-reserved — verify locally unless deployed behavior is required.
policies.cursorDescription: Minimize Vercel preview deployments — verify locally unless deployed behavior is required.

policies.heading: GitNexus index
policies.title: GitNexus index
policies.pointer: **GitNexus** index is session-local — run `npm run gitnexus:startup`, never commit `.gitnexus/`.
policies.cursorDescription: GitNexus index is session-local and gitignored — never commit it.

policies.heading: Scripts over instructions
policies.title: Scripts over instructions
policies.pointer: Put policy in **scripts**, not agent prose — one pointer beats a duplicated paragraph.
policies.cursorDescription: Prefer repo scripts and workflows over duplicating the same steps in agent docs.

policies.heading: Trains H and I
policies.title: Trains H and I — derive the plan, don't remember it
policies.pointer: Train **H/I** slice state is derived from the tree, never stored — run `npm run train:next` to see what is startable.
policies.cursorDescription: Trains H/I: doneness comes from probes over the tree; never mark a slice done, never answer a blocked decision.

staticCursorRules.description: Matt Pocock skills are global-only; never vendor them in this repo
staticCursorRules.title: Matt Pocock skills — global only
staticCursorRules.body:
- Canonical skill files live in `~/.agents/skills` (user-global). Do not vendor them under `.agents/skills/` in this repo.
- Never add `skills-lock.json` here. Upgrade globally with `node scripts/install-global-skills.mjs`.
- Never commit `agent/` or `.claude/skills/<matt-skill>/` junctions/copies from the installer; keep gitnexus skills under `.claude/skills/gitnexus/` only.
- `npm run skills:check` asserts this repo has no vendored Matt trees. See [docs/agents/skills-lock.md](../../docs/agents/skills-lock.md).
- **Always follow Matt standards** — read [docs/agents/matt-standards.md](../../docs/agents/matt-standards.md) and the matching global skill before design/review/refactor.
- Issue tracker, triage labels, and domain layout are configured in `docs/agents/` — engineering skills read those files.
- Grow domain language via `/grill-with-docs` into root `CONTEXT.md` and `docs/adr/`; do not invent empty stubs.

staticCursorRules.description: Always follow Matt Pocock global skills for design, review, refactor, and agent docs.
staticCursorRules.title: Matt standards — always apply
staticCursorRules.body:
Read **[docs/agents/matt-standards.md](../../docs/agents/matt-standards.md)** at session start for the skill map and repo-specific rules.

## Non-negotiable

- **Global skills only** (`~/.agents/skills`) — never vendor. See `.cursor/rules/matt-pocock-skills.mdc`.
- **Deep modules** — small interface, testable core. Packages via entry points; automation via `scripts/lib/`.
- **Scripts over instructions** — policy in `scripts/lib` + JSON; agent docs link, don't restate. See `.cursor/rules/scripts-over-instructions.mdc`.
- **Before editing** a module seam or reviewing a diff: read the matching global skill (`codebase-design`, `code-review`, `writing-for-agents`, `tdd`, …) from `docs/agents/matt-standards.md`.
- **Before merging** a PR: run `npm run test:pre-merge-vertical` (static + browser vertical when the diff warrants it). See [docs/agents/ci.md](../../docs/agents/ci.md).

When in doubt, read the skill file first — do not improvise a second standard.
